Liquor with no taste. What a sensible occupation I had found for myself.

Settling the quarrel, building peace—none of it possible.

A man like me was never going to do such things.

...I had known that from the beginning.
For a moment, I had seen a dream. Then the dream had ended.

Bas. That was the entire story.

What remained was reality.
I could do nothing.

I had found some peace. Something I had not known since killing Hikaru—no, since killing my foster mother. It had been absent for so long.

The warmth beside me felt precious.

Once, I had wanted the coldness of iron from Muramasa. Now, from the very same person, I wanted the warmth of a living companion.

...Truly, there was no saving me from myself.

I laughed at that.

Sleepiness came. I sank into gentle mud.

For the first time in two years, I slept deeply.
